description: CIDR math: IPv4 and IPv6 overlap, adjacency, merge, subtract, membership — Computes exact CIDR relations for agents planning networks, firewall rules or allow-lists: for up to 200 IPv4/IPv6 blocks it reports which pairs are equal, nested, partially overlapping or merely adjacent, the minimal merged CIDR list, a subtraction (blocks minus exclusions), address membership with the most specific match, or each block's first/last address, count and host-bits-set errors. normalizeMapped.description: Treat ::ffff:a.b.c.d (and prefixes of 96 bits or longer inside ::ffff:0:0/96) as the IPv4 block a.b.c.d. Default false.

op.description: inspect: normalize each range and flag host bits set. relations: pairwise equal/contains/overlap/adjacent/disjoint (pass only when no two ranges intersect). merge: minimal CIDR cover of the union. subtract: ranges minus exclude. contains: which ranges contain each address (pass only when every address is covered).

ranges.description: CIDR (10.0.0.0/8, 2001:db8::/32), a bare address (a /32 or /128), or an inclusive range 10.0.0.1-10.0.0.9.

name: cidr-math
